dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: #You must be the world-famous {NICKNAME}! And this must be the Traveler's best companion, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! How did you know our names?

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: You are the island's most distinguished guests, of course I know who you are! After all, I am...

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: I am the world-famous Head of Twilight Theater!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't believe someone would call himself world-famous.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You say you're world-famous, but we've never heard of you.

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: After a painstaking amount of work, our play, "Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess," is finally ready for the stage!

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: There are five acts in this play, each with two scenes...

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: My distinguished guests, you have come at the perfect time! The show is about to start! Please take a seat!

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: I still need to take care of something backstage. Please excuse me.

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: You are about to witness the debut of Twilight Theater's best ever play! Please sit back and enjoy!
